method.xfaMethod: deterministic packet extraction from pinned official sample PDF

sourceConflicts: The XSD permits zero-to-four-character stem-cell line values; Forms-I instructions call for a four-digit registry number. The applicant-facing declaration follows the instructions and preserves the XSD envelope as conflict evidence.

The XSD permits an empty Program Income Source string; the DAT and instructions require a populated row to be complete. The applicant-facing declaration requires a nonempty source while preserving the conflict.

The live G.210 HTML is mutable and a later retrieval produced digest 3ec0fd43f8c9bbad98e08fef0c5856c5e80f7191bf0ccdbd017b02185d3ce9d4. The pinned Forms-I PDF is the stable instruction artifact; the observed HTML digest remains explicit rather than silently replaced.
The Forms-I G.210 introductory text mentions human-subject information, but the authoritative version 5.0 XSD contains no human-subject field. No such question was invented.
An older NIH illustrative PDF has digest 9f1362acf0709e1f1e277c4940017c15e0e7d4459e0be497911cb32690932d64 and expired OMB metadata; it is not used as the current form oracle.
unresolvedBehavior: Vertebrate-animal applicability depends on R&R Other Project Information.
Inventions and patents applicability depends on R&R SF-424 application type.
Change indicators are restricted by New and Revision application contexts.
Program-income row editing, partially populated row handling, and multi-project/training profiles require consumer and application-context decisions.
The hESC checkbox and cell-line list require mutual exclusion and clearing semantics that are not emitted by the current generic condition contract.
HFT attachment filename policies cannot be validated from the opaque attachment identifier alone.
Multi-project Overall-versus-Other aggregation, summary, and discard behavior remains application-context evidence.
Conditional stale-value clearing and non-emission require consumer verification before parity can be claimed.

accessibilityBoundary.verified: Stable labels, sections, cardinalities, conditional targets, and attachment controls are emitted for deterministic consumer testing.

parityClaim: The implementation proves exact schema and XML boundaries plus a bounded subset of source conditions. It does not claim complete PDF, XFA, application-context, accessibility, privacy, or production parity.
